## How this course works {#sec-how-it-works}

- **Weekly slides**, linked from the [Schedule](schedule.qmd).
- **Weekly homeworks**, distributed through the course GitHub org. Each one ships with a
  **sample solution** published after the due date.
- **A final take-home exam**: a complete 8-step Bayesian analysis. You see the target from
  week 1, and every week builds toward it.

New terminology arrives quickly in a course like this.
The [Glossary](glossary.qmd) collects it in one place, grouped by the block where each term first
comes up.

Before the first session, work through the [Installation guide](installation.qmd).
It sets up R, Positron, Quarto, Git and the packages we rely on, and doing it early leaves time
to fix problems that are much easier to solve together.

## Feedback policy, please read {#sec-feedback-policy}

> **A sample solution is published for every homework. Individual feedback is NOT provided by
> default.** The only individual feedback available is the **optional AI feedback** you can opt
> into by adding an open-source `license.md` to your submission repo. See the
> [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd) for details.
